title: Register with the construction industry long service scheme
what: Register with the scheme as an employer of workers covered by the state or territory's portable long service leave scheme.

laws.title: Building and Construction Industry (Portable Long Service Leave) Act 1991 (Qld)

sources.title: Building and Construction Industry (Portable Long Service Leave) Act 1991 (Qld)
sources.quote: 43 Application for registration (1) An employer in the building and construction industry (whether or not the employer carries on any other business) that engages workers must register as an employer under this division.

reach.condition: if it employs workers in the building and construction industry as the state scheme defines it

assessment.summary: Employers in a covered industry must register with its portable long service leave scheme.

marks.reason: Workers keep their long service entitlement when they move between employers in the industry.
Registration, quarterly service returns and the levy.
